review_scope: Initial ledger seed and public-claim guard only; no runtime protocol behavior changes.
addenda_errata_status: Not checked in this initial local seed; re-check current addenda/errata before each protocol PR.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet four-layer collapsed architecture is represented by focused crates for application, network, and data-link responsibilities.
rows.notes: Initial architecture row; later PRs should map exact Clause 4 responsibilities to crate boundaries.

rows.requirement_summary: Client transaction state machine behavior, timeouts, retries, aborts, and segmented response handling.
rows.notes: Requires explicit Clause 5 transition and timeout matrix.

rows.requirement_summary: Server transaction state machine behavior, segmented request handling, SegmentACK behavior, and abort/reject mapping.
rows.notes: Requires independent audit of server TSM states and failure mapping.

rows.requirement_summary: Only Confirmed-Request and ComplexACK may be segmented; SegmentACK windows and modulo-256 sequence handling are enforced.
rows.notes: Needs duplicate, gap, out-of-order, final segment, max APDU, and max segment tests.

rows.requirement_summary: NPDU version, control bits, priority, DER, DNET/DADR/SNET/SADR, and hop count validation.
rows.notes: Reserved-bit and malformed-address negative tests remain required.

rows.requirement_summary: Router discovery, route tables, network messages, reject reasons, busy/available messages, and broadcast forwarding behavior.
rows.notes: Needs in-memory or Docker multi-network conformance evidence.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet Ethernet LLC framing and platform-specific raw Ethernet support are validated or explicitly limited.
rows.notes: Hardware/raw-socket validation should remain opt-in and out of default CI.

rows.requirement_summary: ARCNET data-link support status is classified with source evidence.
rows.notes: No public support claim found in the initial scan.

rows.requirement_summary: MS/TP frame encode/decode, CRC, address validation, extended-frame handling, and serial transport assumptions.
rows.notes: Needs clause-level review and hardware assumptions documented separately.

rows.requirement_summary: PTP data-link support status is classified with source evidence.
rows.notes: No public support claim found in the initial scan.

rows.requirement_summary: LonTalk data-link support status is classified with source evidence.
rows.notes: No public support claim found in the initial scan.

rows.requirement_summary: Claimed object families and services have required-property, optional-property, writable-property, service parameter, and error mapping evidence.
rows.notes: Initial family row only; later work should split high-claim services and object families into detailed rows.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet encoding, application tags, constructed data, and malformed encoding behavior are validated.
rows.notes: Needs a complete malformed fixture catalog and byte-equivalence guard for optimizations.

rows.requirement_summary: Formal APDU structures, service choices, errors, rejects, aborts, and confirmed/unconfirmed service encodings are validated.
rows.notes: Needs service-by-service fixture coverage in later PRs.

rows.requirement_summary: PICS output is generated as draft internal support evidence until formal BTL/PICS evidence exists.
rows.notes: This ledger does not claim certification.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/IPv4 BVLC type, function code, and length handling is table-tested for every exposed function.
rows.notes: Needs explicit all-function table and malformed length/type cases.

rows.requirement_summary: Original-Unicast-NPDU frames preserve exact BVLC length, payload validation, and source/reply semantics.
rows.notes: Needs malformed and reply-path tests.

rows.requirement_summary: Original-Broadcast-NPDU frames are encoded, decoded, and routed according to BACnet/IP broadcast semantics.
rows.notes: Needs local, remote, and global broadcast tests.

rows.requirement_summary: Forwarded-NPDU includes a valid originating BACnet/IP MAC and preserves source-address semantics.
rows.notes: Needs truncated-originating-address and echo/loop-prevention tests.

rows.requirement_summary: BBMD Broadcast Distribution Table write/read/ACK behavior and peer broadcast fanout are validated.
rows.notes: Needs BDT overwrite, read ACK, fanout, and loop prevention tests.

rows.requirement_summary: Foreign-device registration, TTL bounds, re-registration, read/delete FDT, expiry, and DBTN authorization are validated.
rows.notes: Needs unregistered/expired foreign device rejection evidence.

rows.requirement_summary: BIBB support is generated from ledger/service evidence as a draft internal summary, not a certification claim.
rows.notes: Detailed BIBB rows should be generated from service-specific evidence in later work.

rows.requirement_summary: Device profile support is derived from ledger/PICS evidence and remains draft until formal validation.
rows.notes: No profile certification claim is made by this seed.

rows.requirement_summary: ZigBee data-link support status is classified with source evidence.
rows.notes: No public support claim found in the initial scan.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/IPv6 BVLC function codes, address handling, and multicast scope behavior are validated.
rows.notes: Needs Annex U-specific malformed frame and multicast-scope tests.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/SC BVLC-SC frame function, control, options, VMAC, and payload validation.
rows.notes: Needs Table AB-1, reserved-bit, unknown must-understand option, and VMAC tests.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/SC hub connector, hub relay behavior, VMAC routing, disconnect, and failover behavior are validated.
rows.notes: Needs duplicate VMAC, forwarding, direct-connection, and failover matrix.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/SC WebSocket subprotocol, binary frames, wss/TLS, TLS 1.3, and mutual TLS expectations are enforced or explicitly limited.
rows.notes: Server-auth-only examples must remain clearly non-conformant/experimental unless mTLS requirements are satisfied.

rows.requirement_summary: BACnet/SC heartbeat request/ack behavior, timeout range, disconnect, and retry behavior are validated.
rows.notes: Needs fast deterministic timeout tests.
